---
title: "Daniele Goldoni awarded for his PhD thesis at the Forum Nazionale delle Misure"
description: "Daniele Goldoni's PhD thesis receives an award at the 2026 Forum Nazionale delle Misure in Reggio Calabria."
canonical-url: "https://optolab-unimore.github.io/news/items/2026-09-07-goldoni-phd-thesis-award.html"
date: 2026-09-07
categories: [Award]
---

Daniele Goldoni, post-doctoral researcher at OptoLAB, has received an award for his PhD thesis at the **Forum Nazionale delle Misure**, the annual national forum organized by GMEE (Gruppo Misure Elettriche ed Elettroniche), held at Università Mediterranea di Reggio Calabria on 7-9 September 2026.

More details about the award and the thesis will follow.
